summary: AI-powered web scraping and browser automation tools have matured significantly by 2026, with LLM-native APIs, natural language queries, and autonomous agents becoming standard rather than experimental features. The market has bifurcated into developer-first API platforms (Firecrawl, Apify, AgentQL) and managed browser infrastructure layers (Browserbase, Browserless, Scrapfly), while traditional tools like Playwright and Puppeteer increasingly integrate AI extensions. Adoption is driven by RAG pipelines, AI agent workflows, and competitive intelligence use cases requiring clean, structured data at scale.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open-source; cloud providers (Browserbase, Browserless) add paid managed layers
ai_features: AI-assisted selector generation via Copilot integrations
Natural language test and script generation via third-party LLM plugins
Auto-healing locators with AI selector fallback
Integration with AgentQL for NL-powered element queries
strengths: Largest developer mindshare and GitHub stars (60k+)
Cross-browser support (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit)
First-class TypeScript and Python SDKs
Rich ecosystem of AI and cloud extensions
Actively maintained by Microsoft
tools.best_for: Full browser automation, end-to-end testing, and foundation layer for AI agent pipelines requiring reliable cross-browser control
